[B4] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > .
